verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub feature list names "Typo Tolerance" as a capability, alongside "Exact Match" as a contrasting matching mode, so fuzzy matching for misspellings exists. However, the evidence is only a bare feature-list label: nothing shows whether it is enabled by default or how to configure it. missing for 10: evidence that typo tolerance is on out of the box, documented tunable rules (tolerance/edit-distance settings, per-field or word-length thresholds, when fuzzy matching applies), in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
